body.name: \(\mathsf H_{\mathrm{tan}}\)
body.construction: For each cohort set \(w_g^{(L)}=(Y_g-m_g)\mathbf 1\{\|Y_g-m_g\|_2\le L\}\) and \(u_g^{(L)}=w_g^{(L)}-\mathbb E_Pw_g^{(L)}\); choose finite \(L_g\) for which \(C_g=\mathbb E_P[(Y_g-m_g)u_g^{(L_g)\prime}]\) is invertible, which exists because \(C_g\to\Sigma_g\succ0\). For \(s\in L_2^0(P)\) with \(z(s)=Jv\), truncate and center to \(s_g^{[\ell]}\), and set \(\widetilde s_g^{[\ell]}=s_g^{[\ell]}+u_g^{(L_g)\prime}C_g^{-1}[z_g(s)-z_g(s^{[\ell]})]\). With the smooth mean chart \(m_{\eta}\), define \(dP_{g,\varepsilon}^{[\ell]}/dP_g=1+\varepsilon\widetilde s_g^{[\ell]}+u_g^{(L_g)\prime}\lambda_g^{[\ell]}(\varepsilon)\), where \(\lambda_g^{[\ell]}(\varepsilon)=C_g^{-1}[m_{\eta,g}(\eta+\varepsilon v)-m_g-\varepsilon z_g(s)]\). For sufficiently small positive and negative \(\varepsilon\), this is a positive support-preserving density, has mean \(m_{\eta,g}(\eta+\varepsilon v)\), and score \(\widetilde s_g^{[\ell]}\)
